name: The Wall of Ice and Goo
description: A desolate expanse of Antarctic ice, howling with a blinding snowstorm. Massive ley lines flare in a 16-line pattern of black and azure fire. The ground is a mix of jagged ice and pools of black nanite goo.

zones.name: The Snowfield
zones.description: Wide-open ice field with zero cover and blinding wind.

zones.name: Ice Spires
zones.description: Massive chunks of ice jutting from the ground.

zones.name: The Breach
zones.description: The nexus of the ley lines, surrounded by hazardous black goo.
